verified_events.event: Undergraduate movement restrictions announced, initially through September 21.

sources.title: Message to students: COVID-19 clarifications and reminders
sources.locator: Main article, undergraduate essential-activity restriction bullet
sources.excerpt: Undergraduate students are directed to limit their in-person interactions to only essential activities at least through Sept. 25.

verified_events.event: Undergraduate restrictions extended from September 21 to align with the instruction pause; the notice says at least through September 25.
The pause in in-person undergraduate, graduate and professional group instruction remains in place at least until this time.

model_assumptions: Community retention c and residence multipliers 1.0, 1.15, 1.25 are preset experimental assumptions, not measured historical effects.
Instruction and undergraduate community recovery multipliers 0.25, 0.50, 0.75 are sensitivity assumptions, not measured historical effects.
The October 30 simulation endpoint covers the rise, restrictions, decline and partial recovery; later dashboard data exist.
The one-day reporting alignment follows E0 and is not a verified historical specimen-to-report delay.
